events.description: 17. MINUTE ORDER (text only): Plaintiffs' motion for a temporary restraining order, Dkt. No. 12, is pending. This morning, the Ninth Circuit, sitting en banc, reinstated the panel order staying the temporary restraining order in SEIU v. U.S. Department of Justice, No. 3:26-cv-12800-TLT (N.D. Cal.). See SEIU v. U.S. Dept of Just., No. 26-7303 (9th Cir. Nov. 3, 2026). That order bears directly on the relief Plaintiffs seek here. Plaintiffs are DIRECTED to file a supplemental brief, not to exceed 4,200 words, addressing the effect of the Ninth Circuit's order on their motion, by Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. (PT). Defendants' response under LCR 65(b)(5) remains due as provided in that rule. Authorized by Judge Jamal N Whitehead. (KRA) (Entered: 11/03/2026)

events.description: 21. ORDER GRANTING TEMPORARY RESTRAINING ORDER IN PART. It is hereby ORDERED that Plaintiffs' 12 TRO motion is GRANTED in part as detailed herein. Defendants are FURTHER ORDERED to show cause why a preliminary injunction to the same effect should not issue. Defendants must file any opposition to Plaintiffs' motion for a preliminary injunction, Dkt. No. 12, by 11/12/2026. Plaintiffs may file a reply, if any, by 11/16/2026. The Court will hear the motion on 11/18/2026, at 1:30 p.m. (PT), in Courtroom 16A. This order takes effect immediately and will remain in effect for FOURTEEN (14) days from the date of entry, unless and until extended by further order of this Court. Signed by Judge Jamal N Whitehead. (KRA) (Entered: 11/05/2026)
